dialogues.speaker: Leisurely Springvale Contestant
dialogues.text: It's not about winning, it's about taking part.

dialogues.speaker: Self-Confident Sumeru Contestant
dialogues.text: This climate is so much better than the desert. And the food here's not bad either.

dialogues.speaker: Deeply Suspicious Liyue Contestant
dialogues.text: We're here for a cross-country relay race. We should be out on the course checking things out. What good will it do us to sit here meditating?

dialogues.speaker: Liyue Contestant Training in Martial Arts
dialogues.text: Do not panic. Great trials must be faced with a calm spirit... meditation is training for the mind.

dialogues.speaker: Confused Inazuman Contestant
dialogues.text: It's so easy to get lost on this mountain. I almost missed the turning for the camp.

dialogues.speaker: Exasperated Inazuman Contestant
dialogues.text: You can't blame that on the mountain. Yes, it's not the easiest terrain to navigate, but you have no sense of direction. Heck, you can barely find the toilet in your own home!

dialogues.speaker: Fontainian Contestant Shaking From the Cold
dialogues.text: Achoo! Ugh, how is it so cold here? I thought Mondstadt had a gentle climate.

dialogues.speaker: Fontainian Contestant Sneezing From the Cold
dialogues.text: Achoo! Dude, it's a snowy mountain. Of course it's gonna be cold.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Yigang
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm sorry I let you all down.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: You didn't. Nobody's blaming you. It's not like you chose to get sick.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Yigang
dialogues.text: Achoo... I'll make sure to bring warmer clothes next time.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: This photo is amazing. Should we take a few more?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Let's do it. We can try some other poses.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Alright, in that case, I'd better go grab some comics. We can look through them for reference.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Hmm, but there's too many good ones to choose from... We'll probably get so caught up in reading comics that we forget to take the photos...

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Before you guys arrived, I did some more artwork for Nepecha. It's boxed up and sitting on my desk, ready to go.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Could you wait for me here, Xilonen? I'll run home and grab it. I'll try not to be too long.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Are you kidding me? I'm not waiting here. I'll come with you!

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Oh, even better! Then you can come in for a snack!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Sweet. Lead the way.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, shall we play Snowtrace together?

choices.text: Yeah! We're going to have a blast playing hide-and-seek!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Alright, everybody! It's time to get ready!

choices.text: Did you come all the way to watch the competition, Yaoyao?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Not exactly. Well, it was kind of a coincidence...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Xiangling will be hosting a golden-haired lady wearing a big chef's hat who's visiting from afar, so she's busy preparing fresh and interesting dishes.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: While chatting with Yanfei, she suddenly realized she'd never tried mixing Liyue and Mondstadt cuisines before, so she decided to come to Mondstadt to look for some new recipes.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: But recently, Wanmin Restaurant has been super busy, so she couldn't come herself. That's why I'm tagging along with Yanfei, to go in her place.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Master said I should think of it as a little adventure for me, and that with Yanfei taking care of me, she doesn't have to worry at all.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How's your journey going?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: It was amazing! Besides picking up local recipes from the restaurants, I also visited the huge Knights of Favonius Library and borrowed some more advanced books on Mondstadt cooking theory.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: When we get back, I'll remind Xiangling to study them carefully. I'm sure she'll come up with amazing new dishes — the kind that'll make your jaw drop!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: But you know, it's not just about recipes and books. What's most precious is something you can't really put a value on.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Master always says, "Traveling the world and making lots of friends is one of life's greatest joys." This time, I got to meet Klee and Sayu, and it made me so happy!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Klee's bombs are so powerful! They're perfect when my spear isn't enough to handle lots of bad guys at once. And they're great for practicing dodging too, so you can really build up your basic skills!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Of course, for regular fighters, they can be a bit dangerous... But Klee understands that, and she always makes sure no one's nearby before using her bombs. She's really thoughtful!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: And Sayu's camouflage skills are so cool! I'd never seen techniques like that for hiding yourself before...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: In Liyue's legends, martial artists who master these skills and move unseen often become silent heroes, striking against wrongdoers without a trace.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Next time I visit, I'd like to bring Qiqi along. I have a feeling the four of us would get along really well!

choices.text: Do you like Mondstadt food?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Absolutely! And what surprised me is that some flavors actually feel quite familiar, like the Northern Smoked Chicken — it has a comforting similarity to Liyue cuisine.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Oh, and I also found something interesting in one of the books I borrowed for Xiangling! It mentioned that Mondstadt used to have a tradition of making specially pickled sour vegetables.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Just from the description and the way it's made, it's similar to a Liyue specialty Master once told me about. She said the miners at Blackcliff Forge really love it – what an interesting coincidence!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: When I go back, I'll bring along some Mondstadt dishes that keep well. Next time we go on a picnic with Qiqi, she can try them too.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: And of course, I'll prepare a special portion just for you! I've heard so many legendary stories about you here in Mondstadt — you probably know the traditional dishes inside out by now.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: So I'll put on my thinking cap and try combining Qingce Stir Fry with Mondstadt ingredients... just to give you a little surprise!

choices.text: I'll come play in a bit.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: No problem! We'll be here!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #I'm so happy right now! Are you happy too, {M#Mr. Honorary Knight}{F#Miss Honorary Knight}?

choices.text: It's always fun when we're with you, Klee!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hooray! Let's keep playing hide-and-seek!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: The first time I saw this game, people were playing it on a table...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: But I thought, what if we tried really acting like the characters in the game? So I told Albedo that idea.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: And Albedo just happened to make these super magical things... hmm, what were they called again...? Oh yeah, alchemy gadgets! They're just like Whopperflowers!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: We put the gadgets all around the hide-and-seek area, and they can look like all sorts of little boxes. Then we can play using the same rules as the tabletop game!

choices.text: Klee and Albedo are so clever!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #I come to Dragonspine to see Albedo all the time, so I'm not afraid of the cold. But {M#Mr. Honorary Knight}{F#Miss Honorary Knight}, you have to be careful, okay? Don't catch a cold!

choices.text: Hooray! Hide-and-Seek is even cooler now!
Anything else fun to share?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah! Some really strong-looking ladies came all the way from Natlan and gave me a special kind of storybook... It's called a comic!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: The people in the comics are all so cool! I want to draw comics about Mondstadt too...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Like... {M#Mr. Honorary Knight}{F#Miss Honorary Knight} going on a big treasure-hunting adventure with Klee!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: And stories about Mom and her friends too! Aunt Nicole, Aunt Barbie, and Aunt Octavia...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: And then, my new friends, Yaoyao and Sayu, they both have really magical skills! They're amazing!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: There are so many fun things, I couldn't fit them all into even thousands of pages!

choices.text: We're cheering for you, Klee!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: But I can't get that effect with crayons... it seems like I need some special tools. I still have to learn some drawing techniques from Albedo!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Albedo's been working overtime... and he gets really tired, so I shouldn't make him even more tired...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: So when Albedo isn't busy anymore, I will go learn properly from him!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh, one more thing! Yoimiya came to visit too!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: It's been so long since I last saw her, back when we went to Inazuma for that reading festival...

choices.text: You mean the Irodori Festival?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: When Yoimiya was passing by, I spotted her from super far away!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Then I showed her around Mondstadt, walking all over town and trying lots of yummy foods you can only get here!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I also wanted to take her fish blasting, but Master Jean said there are lots of foreign visitors in the city lately... and we can't scare them, or it might give Mondstadt a bad reputation!

choices.text: Klee did a great job being a good host!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hehe, there'll definitely be more chances to go fish-blasting later! I can be patient!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I really want to see Yoimiya's fireworks exploding over Cider Lake in the shape of goldfish!

choices.text: Klee's really growing up to be responsible! Big thumbs up!
Yeah, it really has been a while!
Klee's gonna be a great comic artist!
We'll stop by later!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yay! I'll be waiting for you!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: #*yawn* {NICKNAME}, you're so full of energy. Don't you ever need to rest?

choices.text: Did you enjoy your trip to Dragonspine, Sayu?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Mmm... if you don't count Sumire's training sessions, the work part was actually pretty relaxed.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Ah, forgot to tell you — Sumire's the new inspector. She was leading this Shuumatsuban mission to Dragonspine, and honestly... she kept a closer eye on me than any shrine maiden ever has...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Earlier, they sent some people to participate in some kind of war game simulation... to gain experience, I guess.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Then that representative named Kuromaro, returned with a bunch of reports. He got support from some higher-ups, and started contacting Hatamoto everywhere to roll out new training methods. Even the Shuumatsuban got swept up in it...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I don't really get all the details... but the Yoohoo Art isn't even suited for head-on combat! Why do they have to push me so hard...? It's pointless...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: The most I can do is teach their new Ninken, that little Gaumaru, how to hide better and nap anywhere, anytime.

choices.text: Oh... so they made you do extra training?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I've gotta thank Klee and Yaoyao for this...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: When we first got to Mondstadt, while handling paperwork at the Knights of Favonius, Klee got curious about the tail on my outfit and asked me a bunch of questions...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Then she invited me to this camp, where we found Yaoyao. After a couple rounds of hide-and-seek, we became friends.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: And Klee even has her own title — "Spark Knight"! Sounds pretty impressive, doesn't it?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: The intel says that anyone in the Knights of Favonius with a special title is basically captain-level. Even their Master's just called the "Lionfang Knight," so... I guess they're kind of on the same level?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: That means Klee's probably just as strong as their Master — and her words count just as much!

choices.text: W—Wait... Is that really how it works?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Anyway, that's how Sumire sees it. She totally respects Klee! The moment Klee said she wanted to play with me, Sumire didn't dare pull me away for training anymore!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: When I'm with Klee and Yaoyao, I feel really at ease.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: People always mistake me for being their age, but that's fine. I get more snacks and gifts, and that's a different kind of happiness...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: If only the boat ride here wasn't so long, and I could get enough sleep every day... maybe I'd visit Klee more often!

choices.text: Well... I mean... technically, that kinda makes sense..
But you don't seem busy right now, huh?
Is there anything else in Mondstadt that interests you?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Hmm... It's the bass in Cider Lake!

choices.text: Huh? That's... an unexpected answer.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Mm-hmm. Klee showed me a photo of her mom — she's super tall!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: And usually, kids don't grow shorter than their parents, so that means Klee's gonna be tall too!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Klee said she loves the freshly-blasted bass from Cider Lake, and her mom likes it too. So that must mean the bass there is super good for you — and it probably helps you grow taller!

choices.text: That's easy. I can catch you a couple myself...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Really? Ah, you don't have to go through all that trouble!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Now that I think about it, buying freshly caught fish and grilling them the local way should be just as good, right? After all, even bass that's been blasted out of the lake still needs to be cooked properly before you can eat it...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I'll try it myself first!

choices.text: I happen to know a little about the "Klee-style fish blasting" method...
Is it because of Klee's taste?
You're right... I should go get some rest too.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Mm-hmm. You may not need to grow taller anymore, but getting more sleep is never a bad idea!

dialogues.speaker: Sumire
dialogues.text: So, are you ready to challenge the Frostarm Lawachurl?

dialogues.speaker: Gaumaru
dialogues.text: Grr... Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Sumire
dialogues.text: Then focus on your training. You'll be able to do it one day!

dialogues.speaker: Sumire
dialogues.text: Soon, at the martial arts tournament, you'll have your first chance to show what you've got.

dialogues.speaker: Sumire
dialogues.text: As the newest generation of the Shuumatsuban's Ninken, I believe you'll go further than any of your predecessors.

dialogues.speaker: Sumire
dialogues.text: Of course, it's not all about combat. Your tracking skills need work, too.

dialogues.speaker: Sumire
dialogues.text: Your next goal is to find Master Sayu while she's hiding and napping in less than five times the time Miss Kano Nana took. Think you can handle that?

dialogues.speaker: Gaumaru
dialogues.text: Arf-wooo!

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: We're ready now. O great hero, do you wish to take the Saury-Saury Scout out on a test flight?

choices.text: Let's go!

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: Here we go! I believe the rapport you've built with your Saurian companions will really help you when you're in command of the Saury-Saury Scout!

choices.text: Are you here for the contest, too?

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: You're giving me too much credit! I'm not strong enough to compete! I just stopped by to pick up some materials and do some recruiting, that's all.

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: Ever since you and the Pyro Archon — not to mention all those brave warriors — quelled the great crisis, the people of Natlan have been able to travel...

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: Our Graffiti Alliance has been expanding and recruiting talented artists from all over the world!

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: Graffiti is a form of expression. When it comes to specific styles, there are plenty of examples of people borrowing techniques from comic books. In fact, I've taken a few commissions drawing comics myself...

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: Translating a highly dynamic scene from paper to a wall is quite an achievement.

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: I'm really looking forward to seeing how the people of Mondstadt adapt their distinctive art style into graffiti and display it on the walls and mountains.

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: Of course, the most important thing is that everyone only creates graffiti in the areas permitted by the administrators — they should never intentionally damage the local scenery!

choices.text: How did you end up working with Mika?

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: I'm so lucky to have met such a professional knight!

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: As the Graffiti Alliance's Guru-in-Chief, I registered with the Adventurers' Guild early on to make it easier to conduct surveys abroad.

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: That way, when I'm scouting for suitable graffiti locations, I won't be arrested for looking suspicious.

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: But the biting cold on Dragonspine and its monstrous residents didn't seem impressed by my membership — they nearly turned me into a permanent icy exhibit...

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: Thankfully, Mika found me and led me to safety — otherwise, I might have been done for.

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: Afterwards, it got me thinking — there must be plenty of adventurers who've been stuck in similar situations. Even Mika agreed that surveying the terrain can sometimes be too dangerous...

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: So we tossed some ideas back and forth until we came up with the "Saury-Saury Scout."

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: Hopefully, once we've collected enough data, the "Saury-Saury Scout" can go into mass production, helping more adventurers... and future Graffiti Alliance members!

choices.text: I'll come back later...

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: Okay! We'll be waiting!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: #{M#Sir}{F#Ma'am}, once you've finished testing the "Saury-Saury Scout," if you have any feedback, please don't hesitate to let me know... even if you think it's terrible!

choices.text: Isn't it a little strange to address me as such?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Strange? What do you mean?

choices.text: When it comes to being a knight, you have more experience than me.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Ah... You're right, I've never called you that before. It might have made you uncomfortable. I won't do it again!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: It's just... during the International Cross Country Challenge, I met several friends from Natlan and heard of your legendary deeds from a completely new perspective.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: You triumphed in the face of catastrophe and emerged as a great hero of Natlan. You worked side by side with people whose prowess is on a level I never thought possible...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Both your adventures and the way you treat people are so impressive. I admire everything you've accomplished. Your achievements shine as bright as the stars!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Compared to that, I feel like I haven't made much progress at all lately...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: It feels like before, I was striving just to catch up with you, but now your progress is so fast you're almost out of sight...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: #So, it just felt natural to start calling you {M#sir}{F#ma'am}...

choices.text: Don't be so hard on yourself! You'll get stronger too!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Oh... Thanks! I'll definitely keep honing my skills. Gotta keep pushing myself!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: But just burying my head in training and relying solely on diligence... doesn't seem like the right approach either. I need to change my mindset.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: I'm gonna try to find more opportunities to experience new things, to break away from fixed ways of thinking...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: And this collaborative effort to improve the "Saury-Saury Scout" is a great place to start!

choices.text: We should train together sometime!
Who cares about experience — we're friends, aren't we?
Won't these survey devices put you out of a job?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: The battle between mechanisms and people... I've actually pondered this issue before.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: When I was in Nod-Krai, I read three books written by engineers from Fontaine and Liyue — they gave me quite a few insights.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Mechanisms with unlimited energy that can be controlled from a distance could indeed replace surveyors like me — and maybe even other knights with different roles.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: One of our fellow knights, after studying Fontaine's Gardemeks, once told me, "There will come a day when wars are fought by unmanned mechanisms, without the need for knights or soldiers."

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: But that would require perfect operating conditions. Even if you only consider power supply and operational strategies, there are clear issues that mechanisms alone are unable to solve.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Most mechanisms can't simply deploy from a base, reach a target location, and then begin their mission. If they did, who knows how much of their stored energy would be depleted before the mission even began?

choices.text: That's a good point... There are too many uncertainties along the way.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: That's true. Generally, the operator needs to transport the mechanism to a suitable location before putting it to work. The whole mission is then kept under human supervision in case unexpected circumstances arise.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: In order to produce a mechanism that can work without supervision, a lot more research and development is required.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: So I'm inclined to think that... when it comes to military and adventure applications, mechanisms remain a tool for multiplying human capabilities, rather than a replacement.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: I'd also like to train myself to operate multiple mechanisms by myself to synchronize the survey of larger areas.

choices.text: It's not safe to let mechanisms act independently.
We can talk about that later. Have you been busy lately?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Ah... Thank you for your concern! As you can see, I'm not too busy right now.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: After helping Vice Captain Lohen's old company adjust to their new duties, I came to help with the cross-country challenge. As for the make-up of the next expedition team, personnel assignment should be scheduled for two weeks' time.

choices.text: ...Lohen?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Right. Lohen is the vice captain of the Fifth Company. He was a long-time member of the expedition team, playing a vital role in the mobile contingent.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Recently, the team's mission has changed, and some members of the company are preparing to return to Mondstadt...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: The Fifth Company is a rather special unit. When first formed, they primarily used bows, but as technology has advanced, they've begun equipping themselves with other forms of ranged weaponry...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Normally, they train together as a single unit, but when deployed on missions, they're regularly split into smaller squads and attached to other companies to bolster their firepower.

choices.text: They're split up for combat?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: The Grand Master said this would make our firepower more flexible. By splitting them up, it ensures no single company finds itself outmatched by long-range opponents.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: As a result, the members of the Fifth Company are "always on standby, ready to deploy to the thick of the action." It means their missions are usually quite challenging.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: And even within Fifth Company, Vice Captain Lohen really stands out. He loves going wherever the fighting is thickest and often complains that there aren't enough monsters. I really admire his fighting spirit!

choices.text: He sounds like quite a character... How does he treat you?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: He treats me very well! Every time I finish a survey, he insists on verifying the results with me and organizing the intelligence right away...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: If there are any gaps in the survey data, the Vice Captain takes it upon himself to perform "armed recon" to get me the most precise information possible.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: As for his practical jokes... once you get used to them, they're not so bad.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: He has a knack for influencing his closest companions — they all tend to favor his preferred tactic of overwhelming assaults, sometimes even neglecting their own safety...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: So, when it comes to personnel management, beyond just finding the right role that allows them to flourish, they also need to be paired with teammates who can temper their more reckless nature...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: This way, they won't get carried away and use overwhelming force on run-of-the-mill, routine missions.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Once you meet Vice Captain Lohen, you'll understand him a lot better...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: For some reason, I feel like the two of you are going to hit it off and end up becoming a perfect match!

choices.text: By which I mean... how do you two get along?
Why not concentrate their firepower?
...Vice Captain?
I need to give it some thought.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: I—I'll look forward to it!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, ready to pack some snowballs and hurl them at the target?

choices.text: I'm ready if you are!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Then let's play!

choices.text: Are you having a good time in Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Of course! Every time I come, there's always something new! Like this time, I finally got to meet Amber!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I'd heard a lot about her from Eula before, and I'd love to make a new friend.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: And the moment we met, I knew we'd get along really well!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Amber spent the day with me, taking photos, visiting places and landmarks, and even trying out the special gliding route in Brightcrown Canyon...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Yesterday, we camped out in the Stormbearer Mountains and caught some tender, fresh fish, and the tofu soup we made was absolutely delicious!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I have to thank Amber for that. After I told Eula in a letter about coming to Mondstadt, Amber also heard about the news.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: She ordered some tofu that's hard to come by in Mondstadt from a merchant in advance, so when we went camping, the ingredients were as good as what you'd get at a restaurant!

choices.text: I wanna try that tofu fish soup...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: That's easy! Next time, let's pick a day when Eula's not working overtime, and the four of us can go camping together! It'll be so much fun!

choices.text: And that kind of trip sounds fun too...
How's your work been?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Everything's going great! I just wrapped up a mediation between merchants over tea resale profits. A classic case, didn't take too much effort.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Work finished up faster than I expected, so I even had time to visit the library with Yaoyao and pick out some new books.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: The Knights of Favonius Library has a completely different vibe from the one in Ministry of Civil Affairs, or any of the bookstores back in Liyue.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I found the full set of "The Evolution of Laws in the Northern Continents" from my reading list, and with Amber's help, got all the paperwork done. I've got it checked out for a whole year!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Yaoyao found the books she was looking for as well! While chatting with the elegant librarian, she even made a new friend. What a fruitful day!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: They're probably trying out that brand-new hide-and-seek game right now. I read the rules and found it very interesting. You should check it out!

choices.text: I'd like to head somewhere else first.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Sure. Remember to come by when you're free!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hey there, Honorary Knight! This cross-country race turned out pretty successful, right?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Besides Jade Pitching, there are a few other fun events too, you may run into plenty of familiar faces!

choices.text: Amber seems pretty busy lately...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Huh? Busy? Me? I wouldn't say that, unless my schedule's packed with patrols and battles, it doesn't really count as busy!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: When we met in Sumeru, I was off-duty and on vacation. I was just having fun, helping Collei with a few things, nothing tiring at all.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: And it's the same this time, just lending a hand with some small tasks here and there around the camp, no pressure whatsoever.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Plus, the Knights of Favonius have also been reorganizing. Master Jean's planning to assign me a few helpers so my schedule won't be as packed as before.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: One of them's a really talented trainee named Gretel. She'll be learning outrider skills from me and hopefully start handling some of the easier tasks soon.

choices.text: Amber's getting an apprentice!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Haha, nothing like that! I'm just sharing a few basic skills, nothing special. I'll still be the Knights' one and only independent Outrider!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Master Jean mentioned that the Knights have learned a lot over the years and we don't plan on forming a separate recon squad.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Instead, each squad's going to develop its own recon team based on their specific duties and strengths.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: The way I'm training Gretel will be used as an example in the teaching materials to inspire future training across all squads...

choices.text: So you're setting the standard now?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Pretty much! To do that, I'll have to write a ton of reports and summaries, that's when things will really start getting busy.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Ugh, paperwork like that always gives me a headache. It's not my strong suit at all.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: At times like this, I should ask Eula for advice... she always balances her missions and captain's desk duties perfectly!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: The only downside is... every now and then, she gets so busy and she practically vanishes. I'll pass on that!

choices.text: The instructor of instructors?
The Outriders are gonna expand their ranks!
Congrats on making a new friend, Amber!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: You mean Yanfei? Haha, then I should be congratulating myself too!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: When Eula first told me about this legal expert, I was a little worried she'd be too strict.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But once we met, I realized I was worrying for nothing!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Though we like different foods, prefer different kinds of books, and have such different stories and experiences in the past...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But it's incredible that many of the things we enjoy fall into the areas the other isn't familiar with, yet has always been curious about.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: That's why, whenever we're hanging out, there's a natural sense of familiarity. When we went camping, we just kept chatting under the stars until way past midnight!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What did you talk about?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: All sorts of things! One topic was about the limits of action, it gave me a lot to think about.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Like, if you've found a suspicious lead but need to enter a citizen's yard to investigate...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: How do you carry out the task in a way that keeps Mondstadt safe without infringing upon people's rights?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Liyue has well-developed regulations for situations like this, we Knights could learn so much from them!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Maybe we'll invite Yanfei to come by as a consultant more often in the future!

choices.text: I'm gonna look around a bit more.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Sure! Have fun!

dialogues.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
dialogues.text: #How are we feeling today, Boss {NICKNAME}? Wanna show us how it's done?

choices.text: Let's start the Trial of Valor!

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Your energy is incredible. I'm gonna have to watch this very, very closely!

choices.text: What kind of work do you do, my friend?

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Me? Working for you!

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Haha, don't be so surprised. I mostly help out at Varesa's shop, hauling goods when we're out on business, and keeping an eye on the warehouse when we're back.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: But Varesa did say, if the great hero ever needs it, the whole fruit stand and orchard are yours to call on!

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: So, in a way, I'm part of your support team too.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Back when I went to Fontaine on business, I really did send you my resume. Don't know if you remember that.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: If you still remember, that alone would be an honor.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: And if you don't... then next time you visit the Collective of Plenty, I'll treat you to a glass of Skysplit Gembloom Grainfruit juice — maybe then you'll remember me!

choices.text: I need to go take care of something else first.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: I understand. I'll see you later then!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! Just seeing you makes me twice as happy. This trip to Mondstadt was totally worth it!

choices.text: Do you want to grab a jacket?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, it's fine, really! It's cold, sure, but it just feels kind of new and interesting, not like I need to bundle up or anything!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: If I'm being serious, I was out there using fireworks to fight monsters not long ago, so yeah, I'm still all warmed up.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Besides, there's a campfire nearby. If I ever do start feeling cold, I can just warm up there. Really, you don't have to worry about me!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: If I put it in a more fun way, being surrounded by so many comic fans has the whole place buzzing, and it's got my own excitement fired up too!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I mean, you're not bundled up in a big coat either! Have a little faith in your companion! I'm tougher than I look.

choices.text: So, Yoimiya, you're here just for the competition this time?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hehe, I just stopped by to watch the competition — my trip to Mondstadt actually has a real purpose this time...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: For the past six months, I've been looking for new materials for my fireworks. I want to make the explosions feel more alive.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I've tried pretty much every common material you can find in Inazuma by now, and some of them actually turned out really well. Like those floaty Sakura Blooms, or the peel from the Lavender Melons everyone's got at home.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: First I soak the two materials in dye for some time. After they air-dry, I give them a thin coating of gunpowder that's been mixed with a shaping binder, and make them into little firework charges...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Next I carve each tiny firework charge, balance their weights precisely, and nestle them into the tube in a custom formation...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: When the firework goes off, those little charges are blasted outward and follow the paths I planned, painting the sky with finer, more detailed patterns, sometimes even a whole picture!

choices.text: That sounds like it takes some serious calculating...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: It's not that complicated! You just keep trying, don't worry about failing, and go with what feels right in your hands. That's how you make the fireworks you want!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: So, following that logic, if I want the firework's picture to stay in the sky a little longer, I'll need to find a lighter material to carry the powder.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: What kind of material could catch the night breeze and keep drifting in the sky like that?

choices.text: The first thing I thought of was... dandelions?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Bingo! We were thinking the exact same thing!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Perfect timing! There's a cross-country race going on, and the boat tickets are cheaper too. With all the excitement around, I figured I'd drop by. Part fun, part business!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: When I got to Mondstadt, I went right out and gathered a bunch of fresh dandelions. Kept them all safe and sound, and just like that, mission accomplished!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But fresh dandelions turned out to be even lighter and more fragile than I remembered. Working with them takes a really delicate touch... guess that's part of the challenge!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Once I manage to make fireworks that burn longer and shine even brighter, you'll be the first one I show them to!

choices.text: A plant unique to the land of wind, Mondstadt?
Sounds like we're drifting into engineering territory here...
What do you think of Mondstadt so far?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hmm... let me think. I've been going slow this trip. Feels like I could fall asleep anywhere in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, that's definitely a good thing! You know, when someone's got a lot on their mind, it's hard to sleep. And when everyone around is rushing about, it's even harder to really relax.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: There's this calm, easygoing feeling in Mondstadt, like the whole place is on vacation all the time. No wonder everyone's so bright and full of energy!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Klee told me the Windblume Festival is the biggest celebration in Mondstadt. But honestly, with how relaxed things are here, I think a few more festivals wouldn't hurt!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: And if that ever happens, I'll bring some of our special fireworks from home to brighten up the celebrations!

choices.text: Have you made any new friends?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Yeah, I have! It's my first time hanging out with people my age from Natlan! There's Varesa — she's Miss Bold Bang Bouldern's boss, and I heard she's an incredible wrestler!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: We grabbed a meal together, and I found out Varesa is really easy to talk to. She's got this soft, gentle way of speaking... It's almost impossible to picture her in a wrestling match!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But she's actually here to meet her pen pal this time, so she's been really busy. We didn't chat for long, just got to know each other a little.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: We both love comics, so I'm sure we'll see each other again if Inazuma ever holds another event like that.

choices.text: Let's chat again later!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Sure! Go take care of what you need to. Everyone in Mondstadt, Natlan, and Inazuma is counting on you!
